# amini.info — crawl rules. The SEO block in every page and sitemap.xml are
# generated by scripts/build_seo.py; see the SEO section of README.md.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
# Old résumé builds CI archives on every regeneration
Disallow: /backup/
# Build scripts, not content
Disallow: /scripts/
# Résumé PDFs and licence/certificate scans: reachable from the pages, but
# they should not compete with the pages themselves for the name
Disallow: /assets/files/
# The cache stamp app.js polls
Disallow: /version.json

Sitemap: https://amini.info/sitemap.xml
